Problem: Root layout's `alternates.canonical:'/'` propagates to every child page. Result: all 7 marketing pages canonicalize to site root. Google sees the whole site as one page.
Suggested Change: Remove `alternates: { canonical: '/' }` from root `metadata` export. Add per-page canonical in each page's `generateMetadata`.
Notes: This is the root cause for 7/7 pages emitting identical canonical.

Suggested Change: app/page.tsx, app/about-us/page.tsx, app/solutions/page.tsx, app/cases/page.tsx, app/hems/page.tsx, app/support/page.tsx, app/for-partners/page.tsx, app/contact-us/page.tsx, app/privacy/page.tsx, app/terms/page.tsx, app/cookies/page.tsx

Problem: `absoluteUrl('/about-us')` returns `https://solavita.uk/about-us` (no trailing slash) but next.config.js sets `trailingSlash:true`. Canonical/OG/Twitter/JSON-LD `@id` URLs disagree with the URL the server actually serves. Googlebot picks one canonicalisation and ignores the declared one.
Suggested Change: Modify `absoluteUrl` to normalise trailing slash for site-relative paths: if path doesn't end with `/` and doesn't start with `#`/`http`, append `/`.
Notes: Anchors like `/solutions#pro` should be passed through unchanged (the `#` path). Use a dedicated `absoluteAssetUrl` for images (no slash).
